course_name_en: Literary Debates in Modern Turkish Literature

learning_outcomes.text: Students who successfully complete this course will be able to list literary debates in Turkish literature.
They will be able to comprehend the reasons for literary debates.
They will be able to classify the periods and actors involved in the debates.
They will be able to analyze the impact of literary debates on the development and change of literature.
They will be able to enumerate which genres and artists were most involved in literary debates.

syllabus_topics: Course topic, purpose, and content. Bibliography and course delivery information. Introduction to concepts of debate, polemic, and criticism.
First literary debate of the Tanzimat period: "Mebhûsetün anhâ". "Harabat" debate between Namık Kemal and Ziya Paşa.
"Zemzeme" and "Demdeme" debates between Recaizade Ekrem and Muallim Naci.
Classics Debate regarding translation of Western classics into Turkish.
"Decadence" debate initiated by Ahmet Midhat Efendi. Debate arising from the rhymes "Âbes" and "Muktebes".
"Tarih-i Kadim" literary feud between Mehmet Akif and Tevfik Fikret.
Resimli Ay magazine and the "We are breaking idols" debate.
Debates arising from the Garip poetry movement.
Literary feud between Peyami Safa and Nazım Hikmet.
Student presentations and Q&A on literary debates.
